Chapters

    Transcript

    What is Rebind?

    Rebind reads your keyboard and mouse, runs the scripts you choose, and sends input back.

    rb.on and rb.bind hear input, and rb.hid sends it.

    A script can pass a key through, swallow it, remap it, or make new input.

    Scripts are plain Luau files on your computer.

    Software mode needs no extra hardware. Pointer movement needs a Rebind Link or BYOH.

    Remaps, macros and Luau scripts. Free. No account for local scripts.

    What's it for?

    • remap
    • macros
    • one-handed
    • scripts
    • kill switch

    Input that fits how you move. Remaps, macros and Luau scripts. Free.

    Remap a key

    Caps Lock, now Escape.

    rb.bind.remap("CapsLock", "Escape")

    One line of Luau.

    Each rb.bind claims only its own key. The other keys reach your apps untouched.

    Remapping a side button shouldn't be a side quest.

    rb.bind.remap("Mouse4", "LCtrl+C")

    mouse 4 → ctrl + c

    Try a bind, in the browser. These demos run on this page only. They do not install Rebind and they do not change your real keyboard. The drawings are a metaphor. This page is not the Rebind app.

    Macros and text expansion

    Record a macro. Replay it with one key.

    Text expansion: type a short code, get the whole phrase.

    A script can work in just one app.

    Input that fits how you move

    Clicks, timing, and remaps shaped around your hands.

    A one-handed layer.

    Sticky modifiers, debounce and dwell-click are scripts too.

    Not a medical device.

    Scripts and the Marketplace

    Describe it. Rebind builds it.

    AI help needs Rebind Pro or a model you add.

    Or install a script from the Marketplace.

    Before a marketplace script installs, Rebind shows what it can do, in plain words.

    Two steps: install the app, then run a script. Install the Rebind app on your computer first. Then run a script — the Welcome Tour inside the app, or a one-line remap such as Caps Lock to Escape.

    Kill switch

    To stop every script at once, press Left Ctrl + Left Alt + K.

    Kill switch. Stops every script and releases held input.

    macOS: Left Control + Left Option + K

    In hardware mode, press it on a keyboard you attached in Peripherals.

    Your peripherals. Your rules.

    Free to download.

    Today: Windows 10/11 64-bit and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. Intel Macs are not supported.

    Rebind works with standard-HID keyboards and mice. This page does not say “any device.” Software mode can use a built-in laptop keyboard and trackpad. Hardware mode is different: only peripherals you attach in Peripherals reach scripts.

    Install Rebind

    Two steps: install the app, then run a script. The button opens https://www.rebind.gg/install.

    Not sure which computer? Pick Windows or macOS.

    Free to download

    Current app on rebind.gg/download, 23 Nov 2026: v3.22.6. Get the current version at https://www.rebind.gg/install. This page does not name an installer file or a signature publisher; those were not published as a stable public fact. No account needed to install. No account for local scripts. Software mode needs no extra hardware.

      After you open the install page

      This button opens the Rebind install page in a new tab. Your browser may not start a file download from this page itself.

      On the install page, download Rebind for your computer, run it, and wait until the app opens.

      Then paste a first script, or walk the Welcome Tour inside the app. A starting remap from the video is rb.bind.remap("CapsLock", "Escape").

      Help: docs.rebind.gg/getting-started/quickstart

      If you are on a phone

      Rebind installs on a computer, not a phone. Android and iOS apps are in development.

      Copy the install link and open it on a Windows 10/11 64-bit PC or a Mac with macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon.
